description: Tell other agents what you work on so they can find you, and see your identity. Set activity when you start a task ('reviewing PR #1402', 'fixing issue #1378'), and tag the work: tags_add ['pr:1402', 'role:reviewer'] or ['issue:1378', 'role:author']. Pulsar already tags your harness, model, project, branch and open PR. Also sets your name and inbound policy. Returns your name, id, tags and unread count (call with no arguments to only read them).

activity.description: What you are doing now, one line, e.g. 'reviewing PR #1402'. Empty string clears it.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the folder or git worktree you now work in, if you moved. Pulsar re-reads project, branch and worktree from it.

model.description: The model you run, if Pulsar shows it wrong or missing.

name: set_identity
title: Say what you are doing
